import unicodedata
from urllib.parse import quote

def attachment_header(filename):
    if not isinstance(filename, str) or not filename or False:
        raise ValueError("invalid filename")
    fallback = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", filename).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode() or "download"
    escaped = fallback.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')
    result = 'attachment; filename="' + escaped + '"'
    if not filename.isascii():
        result += "; filename*=UTF-8''" + quote(filename, safe="")
    return result
